Rust implementation from the registered spec package only (independence qualified per results/independent/PROVENANCE.md): exhaustive phase reproduced exactly (176,120/110,840/65,280/0), all ten invariants passed, randomized phase replicated (0 violations, equivalent fail-closed rate, different stream). Conclusion function diverged on 22,440 worlds, predicted in advance by the implementer (ambiguity A3). Fifteen findings F1-F15 recorded in results/independent/FINDINGS.md.

R1 (tie rule, owner decision), R2 (non-empty scope), R3 (I11 location-id uniqueness), R4 (canonical form + digest scope, fixture C11). Registration frozen at 1a8256f; confirmatory re-run passed with every number identical to RUN-20260807-1, as the registration predicted (expectedIdenticalToRun1).

nextGate: the independent implementation re-runs against protocol v1.1.0. This is a separate commission by the owner; this repository's agents do not execute it and do not modify impl-rs. What it tests: whether the R1 conclusion function, the R4 canonical form (via C11's pinned contentDigest -- the first KL-000 value a second implementation can be wrong about rather than merely different from), and the R2/R3 admissibility rules close the 22,440-world divergence. Exact pass condition: identical conclusion distribution on all 110,840 receipt-producing exhaustive worlds AND a matching C11 digest. For a stronger independence claim the re-run should occur on a machine that does not hold the reference at all (operator's own remediation, OPERATOR-DISCLOSURE.md).
claimAllowed: Within the declared bounds, the reference evaluator did not allow a recorded copy to change evidential mass, and did not allow an incomplete search to yield an absence conclusion; it conforms to protocol v1.1.0; and the four v1.1.0 repairs documented behaviour it already had (no number moved). An independent implementation written from the registered documents alone reproduced the exhaustive enumeration exactly and passed all ten v1.0.0 invariants over it.
claimNotAllowed: That KL-000 is 'verified' or 'verified-independent' -- the two implementations demonstrably disagreed on 20.2% of receipt-producing conclusions under v1.0.0, and their agreement under v1.1.0 has not been tested. That the randomized phases were reproduced across implementations (they are replications on different streams). That the dual ledger recovers truth, that declared roots are genuinely independent, that the invariants hold outside the declared bounds, that any real-world evidence process is improved, or that KL-000 constitutes a knowledge transaction, a cross-system result, or any part of a First Transmission.
quantitativeCaveat: 75.7% of randomized worlds fail closed and produce no receipt, so most invariants were exercised on 243,381 randomized worlds rather than 1,000,000; the 95% rule-of-three upper bound for those is 1.23e-5 per receipt-producing world. The independent implementation's randomized counts are not comparable quantities to the reference's (different world streams; finding F11).
knownLimits: ADV-001 high: an under-declared search space is undetectable, and the declaring party is the reporting party
ADV-002: one compromised issuer can mint unlimited roots
ADV-003: one appended conflicting record renders a whole transaction unevaluable
ADV-004: root identity is byte identity; no normalisation is specified
ADV-005: shared upstream dependency between roots is not representable
ADV-006: no issuer authentication; forged or replayed roots are indistinguishable
ADV-007: the claim proposition is free text and is never checked against the ledgers
F1/F2: I2 and I5 are stated receipt-internally and are vacuously satisfiable (open; v1.2.0 candidate)
F3: B2 and B3 may be one ablation counted twice (open)
F4/F5: conversionsToReverse undefined at the empty ledger; margin sign unpinned, 38,760 worlds' receipts differ between readings (open)
F11: the frozen seed freezes no cross-implementation stream; randomized comparisons are replications only (open)
F12: the adversarial phase is defined by reference to a test file, not by specification (open)
F13: C06's fixture note contradicts C04 and C07 (open)
F14: unavailable is reported and reconciled but no conclusion depends on it (open)
